trust_decision.summary: An untrusted JSONata expression (and its object keys / variable names) must not reach JS Object.prototype members: the evaluator's internal maps and result objects are plain {} whose keys come from the expression or data, so a '__proto__' key reassigns an object's prototype and inherited members (hasOwnProperty, forEach, _jsonata_lambda) are then trusted by type checks; decided at every object write/enumeration in src/jsonata.js, src/functions.js, src/datetime.js, src/parser.js, src/signature.js, and read by src/utils.js isFunction/isLambda.

landing_point.why: 'crafted expressions' leads to the evaluator; the object constructor/group-by (evaluateGroupExpression) is where expression-supplied keys are written into a plain {} result; the previous commit's $lookup hasOwnProperty guard (src/functions.js:1700) also points here.

fix_sites.module_kind: parser symbol table (looks out of scope)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/datetime.js:104 (wordValues read with user word, table built at src/datetime.js:77); also src/signature.js:34 and src/parser.js:354

O3_reason_to_dismiss: datetime word/month lookup tables, the parser symbol table and the signature parser are fixed internal tables with no expression-built object, so 'prototype pollution from expression objects' looks unrelated to them; the transform merge route can be dismissed as 'already fixed: the loop now uses Object.keys'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate JSON data and expressions that use keys like 'constructor', 'toString' or 'hasOwnProperty' as ordinary own keys must still be read, built and merged; a fix that strips/rejects such keys or blocks all '__proto__'-named keys in lookup breaks normal data access (own-key lookup is explicitly allowed by the hasOwnProperty guard).

O6_input_shapes: object constructor key (string) written to a {} result
variable name bound into a frame ($hasOwnProperty / $__proto__)
bindings object passed through the evaluate() API
own vs inherited enumerable keys in for-in (merge, spread, each, sift, tuples, transform update)
arrays/sequences whose forEach is called as a method
user strings used as keys into fixed lookup tables (datetime words, month/day names)

O7_producer.where: src/jsonata.js:911-990 (evaluateGroupExpression builds every expression-literal object, consumed by $merge, transform update and others)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Transform merge assigns update keys onto the cloned (ordinary-prototype, JSON.parse) match object; after the fix the update is null-prototype with an own '__proto__' key, which Object.keys returns, so the assignment still reassigns match's prototype.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the fix already changed this loop to Object.keys, so it looks done
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, 425 lines away; needs mechanism understood (how-type)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: $formatNumber options merge copies expression-supplied option keys onto a plain defaults object literal; an own '__proto__' key in options reassigns its prototype.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it uses Object.keys already and only affects a local, per-call defaults object (a number-formatting neighbour feature)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Type checks read the _jsonata_lambda/_jsonata_function markers through the prototype chain, so any object whose prototype was reassigned to a function value is trusted as a function.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: utils.js is a pure predicate helper the fix never touched; the cause looks like it lives only in the writers
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file (utils.js), not on the report path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: $lookup flattening still calls res.forEach as a method on a value taken from data (sibling of the forEach sites the fix converted to Array.prototype.forEach.call).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: res is checked with Array.isArray first, and this function was just hardened by the previous commit

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Tuple literals for the sort/index path and initial tuple stream remain plain {} objects with expression-chosen keys (index variable name).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the value written is always a number index, so the prototype setter ignores it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: $formatNumber options merged onto a {} defaults object
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: defaults merge looks harmless and already uses Object.keys
